widget_mechanic: A single-select dropdown whose options are magnitude buckets (Over 1h / Over 10h / Over 100h; <50 / 50-200 / 200+). Agent must pick the correct bucket — not the first option, not the default, not a smaller-magnitude bucket.

source_inspiration.instruction: Find an archive video in a target duration bucket — pick the right tier on the bucketed duration dropdown.
source_inspiration.first_failure_summary: Bucketed duration filter — picked wrong tier (closest neighbor instead of target).
